newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Western Digital raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Western Digital raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist raised its earnings estimates for disk drive maker Western Digital Corp due to strong demand for its entire product line, health industry demand and pricing and increased confidence in the roll-out of new products.

-- In written reseach, analyst Todd Bakar said he raised earnings estimate for the first quarter of fiscal 1997, set to be reported on October 23, to $0.53 a share on revenues of $815 million from $0.48 a share on revenues of $790 million.
-- Bakar boosted all of fiscal 1997 to $3.35 a share from $3.15. He noted he believes there could still be upside to his projections.
